description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Spinner of Souls and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Spinner of Souls trigger, putting another creature card from your library into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting a creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Deathrender
uses.cardState: attached to another nontoken creature you control
